figurative_meaning_en: sarcastically overwhelmed with joy; gratified; melted with delight
example_sentences_in_bangla: প্রশংসা শুনে সে চতুর্ভুজ হয়ে গেল।
সাফল্যের পর তার মুখে চতুর্ভুজ ভাব ফুটে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: He became all four-armed upon hearing the praise.
After success, a four-armed expression appeared on his face.
history: Originates from the depiction of Hindu deity Vishnu with four arms, used figuratively to mock someone who becomes overly elated or god-like upon receiving praise.
note: The idiom draws from Hindu iconography, implying elevation to divine status through flattery.
